comparison.objective: Brace a crate using the one dunnage block that fits its bay gap; only the title is available.
comparison.physical_skill: Fit selection and wedging/bracing versus bimanual impact-tool use and fragment collection.

comparison.reason: Tests geometric selection and bracing, not notch fracture or recovery of multiple free tangs.
